scope: Behavior, ARIA and form participation of the web component in happy-dom (node:test). Rendered lengths are covered by the browser geometry check; visual quality and screen-reader output are not certified.
limitations: CSS-only: lengths are verified in the browser geometry check (apps/studio/geometry-check.html), not by these unit tests.
The source list is the direct sources, not every transitive dependency.
React styling parity is checked in the browser: apps/studio/react-check.html compares each React twin with its web component at five sizes ("fails": []).
